certificate.shape_rule: t=R^4*x scales centered profile coefficients by 1/R and squared residual integral by R^2
certificate.axis_zero_convention: step(0)=0; singular_power(0)=0 as an a.e. representative
certificate.endpoint_convention: at nonzero seams choose the cell starting at abs(t); final endpoint included

diagnostics.optimality_scope: Listed root ratios, degrees <= max_degree, levels <= max_levels, one constant core and equal degree on all geometric annuli; expanded slots only, not runtime or arbitrary approximants.
